purpose: Implementation-branch baseline for S1-S6. Supersedes the S0 baseline's whitelist, which conflicted with the plan (it listed dirty.py as modifiable and omitted current_dirty.py / scripts/cleanup_project_artifacts.py / domain.py / storage.py). The S0 baseline is preserved unchanged as S0 evidence.

prerequisite_commit.subject: fix cloud test environment dependency declaration
prerequisite_commit.why: scripts/cloud_solver_monitor.py imports requests directly; no extra declared it. google-cloud-storage pulls it transitively, so the gap only surfaced when the cloud extra was absent -- the state that left 2 test modules uncollectable.

runtime.note: factory_core is byte-identical to bde49712 (verified), so these must equal the S0 values.

comparison_to_feature_branch.note: The feature-branch baseline (9 failed / 2 collection errors) was environment-caused (psutil/requests absent) plus one feature-branch-introduced secret-scan failure. That baseline MUST NOT be used as the gate on this branch.

environment_preparation.requests_declaration: prerequisite commit adds requests>=2.31,<3 to the cloud extra
environment_preparation.node_frontend: npm ci in web/frontend/. Required because a fresh worktree has no node_modules (gitignored, not carried over from the main tree). tests/test_web_frontend_runtime_helpers.py spawns node to import web/frontend/src/*; without it 13 tests fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (vue-router).

reference_docs_authoritative_location.rule: Edit the authoritative copy only. The worktree copies are execution-reference only, kept untracked so the code PR is not polluted by doc-sync churn. When the architecture docs are formally committed, the final versions move into the implementation branch.

environment.why_separate_venv: The main tree's editable install uses a MetaPathFinder (__editable___modeling_factory_2_0_0_finder.py), which takes precedence over PYTHONPATH. Reusing the main .venv would therefore import scripts/ and apps/ from the MAIN tree (scripts/evidence_grounding.py and scripts/verify_provenance.py differ on the feature branch), making the baseline untrustworthy.
environment.frontend_node_modules: locally generated by npm ci; gitignored; NOT part of the source baseline
